title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry — Completion Discount Terms
content:
These are the terms of the completion discount of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry. The figures named below are those of the registry type's completion discount schedule.

**Article 1 — Who, when and where.** During the completion period the registrant or the co-registrant may buy items still on the registry at the completion discount, in the channels of the completion discount (in store, online and in the app). The registry is in completion status, as the registry record shows at the purchase.

**Article 2 — Item timing and units covered.** The item was added to the registry at least the registry type's minimum number of calendar days on the registry before the purchase date, and the discount covers at most the requested quantity of the item still open — the requested quantity of the item's latest item entry, less the guest gifts of that item whose purchase is not returned or cancelled, less the completion purchases of that item.
*Status: no longer in force for a completion discount the registrant redeems on her or his own order line (the registrant's purchase record of the item still in ordered status) while the registry is in completion status; such a line is governed by the current completion discount basis for order lines. Every other completion purchase remains under this clause.*

**Article 3 — Exclusions.** Items of the excluded merchandise classes, items at the excluded price types and gift cards are never discounted. Completion quantity follows the requested quantity not yet purchased by guests, and the discount never applies to gift cards.

**Article 4 — The completion percent.** The completion percent is the registry type's completion discount percent, plus the registry type's completion card bonus percent when the purchase is charged to a Marlowe & Finch card, plus the registrant's Finch Circle registry completion bonus percent (tier held on the purchase date) when the registry type adds the Finch Circle bonus.
*Status: no longer in force for a completion discount the registrant redeems on her or his own order line (the registrant's purchase record of the item still in ordered status) while the registry is in completion status; such a line is governed by the current completion discount basis for order lines. Every other completion purchase remains under this clause.*

**Article 5 — Price and coupon.** It is taken on the unit's selling price and rounded half up to the cent; when a percent-off coupon also applies, the better of the two is taken, never both.
*Status: no longer in force for a completion discount the registrant redeems on her or his own order line (the registrant's purchase record of the item still in ordered status) while the registry is in completion status; such a line is governed by the current completion discount basis for order lines. Every other completion purchase remains under this clause.*

**Article 6 — Cap.** The completion discounts of the registry together never exceed the registry type's completion discount cap, measured by the completion discounts already used on the registry; the purchase that reaches the cap receives only the remainder.

**Article 7 — Returns.** A completion purchase is an ordinary purchase record for returns, but a return refunds only the price paid and does not restore the discount or the cap.

### Status test (Article 1)

| Registry status | Completion discount available |
|---|---|
| completion | yes |
| active, closed or cancelled | no |

### Cap illustration (hypothetical figures)

A registry whose type cap is USD 500.00 has used USD 470.00 of completion discounts. A purchase whose completion discount would be USD 45.00 receives only the remaining USD 30.00, and from then on the cap is used up. If that purchase is later returned, the price paid is refunded, but the USD 30.00 of cap stays used.

superseded_clauses: The item was added to the registry at least completion_item_min_days_on_registry calendar days before the purchase date, and the discount covers at most registry_msr_remaining_requested_quantity units of the sku.

The completion percent is the type's completion_discount_pct, plus completion_card_bonus_pct when the purchase is charged to a Marlowe & Finch card, plus the registrant's Finch Circle registry_completion_bonus_pct (tier held on the purchase date) when the type's loyalty_bonus_applies is true.
It is taken on the unit's selling price and rounded half up to the cent; when a percent-off coupon also applies, the better of the two is taken, never both (completion_coupon_stacking).
